global.description: Global settings for the VPN daemon, controlling service behavior, security, networking defaults, and plugin support.

items.description: Plugin-specific configuration section. Each plugin defines its own keys.

name.description: Name of the plugin (e.g., 'l2tp', 'openvpn', 'sstp'). Used as section header [L2TP], [OPENVPN], etc.

config_lines.description: List of raw key=value lines for this plugin section (e.g., ['L2TPAuthType=MSCHAPV2', 'L2TPMTU=1400']). Each line should be properly formatted.

plugins.description: List of plugin configuration blocks. Each block creates a section [PLUGIN_NAME] in the config.
